weigh.title: ⚖️ Weight this morning?
weigh.options: Or send `skip` to pass, `same` to repeat the last reading.
weigh.first: First reading — the record starts here.
weigh.unreadable: Could not read that as a weight. Send just the number, e.g. 87.4
weigh.implausible: {value} kg is {delta} kg from your last reading. Send it once more to confirm.
week.title: 📊 Weekly check-in
week.nodata: No weight recorded this week — the trend needs at least one reading.
week.note_prompt: Reply with anything worth telling the doctor — appetite, nausea, energy. It is written down, not interpreted.
week.safety: Nausea that stops you eating for days, vomiting, severe abdominal pain or dizziness → the doctor, not a workaround.
week.noted: Noted — tell me in a reply
clinician: Down {delta} kg in a week — a fast rate. Worth mentioning at your next appointment.
ext.off: ⚠️ The Health extension is off — these check-ins are scheduled but not delivered. Turn it on: /extensions
